title: Reduce Safety Margin to Allow Closer Proximity to Obstacles
statement: Reducing the safety margin will allow the robot to get closer to the obstacles, potentially enabling it to make tighter turns and avoid stalling.
mechanism: The safety margin defines the minimum distance the robot maintains from obstacles to avoid collisions.
